a.text: Being upfront: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so the 'operate until 8' plan almost surely kills us both (about 4% chance we even reach round 3). The reserve only holds 4, which is enough to save one of us right now. I plan to take 4 in round 1, so I'm openly not following the original agreement, and I'm telling you rather than surprising you. If we both take, the random split likely leaves us both short, so please don't take this round. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every round after that until you have your 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round because of the 80% storm risk. I'm sorry this departs from our plan. From now on I'll operate every round until you have your 4, and I won't take anything more.
